output.reason: The release note [ev-74120508573f] only names an internal refactor of the controllers to use a condition manager. The linked PR [ev-6067d3897fde] adds that "most reconcilers" now use it to set the Available condition at the end of reconciliation, but it does not say which resource kinds' status conditions change. It also gives no before/after (for example, whether status.conditions[].observedGeneration is now filled in where it wasn't before) and no effect on operators. The changed-file list [ev-933906b439d5] hints at the claim, XR, XRD, usage and package reconcilers and some API types, but it is truncated and doesn't describe the behaviour. To settle subject, change, applicability and consequence, we need the PR diff or docs that state the user-visible status change and the resources it applies to.
